conifer_spruce.name: Spruce
conifer_spruce.desc: Dense narrow bluish spire, branches upturned (Picea).

conifer_pine.name: Pine
conifer_pine.desc: Open, scraggly; clear trunk + tufted upper crown, yellow-green (Pinus).

conifer_fir.name: Fir
conifer_fir.desc: Narrow dark conic with a sharp thin summit, very dense (Abies).

conifer_larch.name: Larch / Tamarack
conifer_larch.desc: Soft sparse cone; a deciduous conifer (golden, then bare) (Larix).

tree_aspen.name: Aspen / Poplar
tree_aspen.desc: Slender, pale bark, open round crown (Populus).

tree_oak.name: Oak
tree_oak.desc: Broad gnarled spreading crown, dark, deep bark (Quercus).

shrub_dogwood.name: Dogwood (spreading)
shrub_dogwood.desc: Broad low spreading clump with bare RED stems (Cornus).

shrub_saskatoon.name: Saskatoon (vase)
shrub_saskatoon.desc: Upright multi-stem vase, fine twigs; purple berries in July (Amelanchier).

shrub_rose.name: Rose (mound)
shrub_rose.desc: Low dense rounded thicket to the ground (Rosa).

shrub_currant.name: Currant (thicket)
shrub_currant.desc: Many fine arching canes; red berries in summer (Ribes).

herb_fireweed.name: Fireweed (erect)
herb_fireweed.desc: Tall erect leafy stem, lance leaves spiralling up (Chamaenerion).

herb_yarrow.name: Yarrow (ferny)
herb_yarrow.desc: Low mound of fine feathery foliage under flat flower stalks (Achillea).

herb_fleabane.name: Fleabane (rosette)
herb_fleabane.desc: Basal leaf rosette under a few wiry flower stalks (Erigeron).

herb_pussytoes.name: Pussytoes (mat)
herb_pussytoes.desc: Low cushion of spoon-shaped basal leaves (Antennaria).

herb_lupine.name: Lupine (erect · palmate compound)
herb_lupine.desc: Same erect form as fireweed, but whorls of leaflets fanning from one point (Lupinus).

herb_bergamot.name: Bergamot (clump · OPPOSITE leaves)
herb_bergamot.desc: Same clump form and lance leaf as the aster — but paired at each node, not spiralled (Monarda).

herb_crocus.name: Prairie Crocus (rosette · deeply cut)
herb_crocus.desc: A rosette of finely dissected leaves, and one of the smallest plants here (Pulsatilla).

herb_bedstraw.name: Bedstraw (mat · WHORLED leaves)
herb_bedstraw.desc: Same low mat as pussytoes, with narrow leaves in rings of three (Galium).

herb_columbine.name: Columbine (ferny · pinnate compound)
herb_columbine.desc: Same ferny mound as yarrow, built from leaflets rather than dissected blades (Aquilegia).

fern.name: Fern
fern.desc: Arching divided fronds from a crown.
